findings.summary: the new test file imports reckon.flight but never uses it; ruff reports F401, so the commit adds a lint finding to a tree whose rule is that a commit adds none
PROBE_REPORT is written immediately after the preceding function with no blank separation, so ruff format --check reports the file would be reformatted
a leftover debug print(output) sits in the end-to-end dispatch test, writing the CLI's output into the captured test log for no assertion

the file named by negative_control_log is byte-identical to probe-baseline-before.log (same md5, same tmp dir pytest-145, same 4.16 s) while the evidence fragment quotes the negative control at 4.53 s, so the named log evidences the unchanged-source baseline run rather than a separately performed restoration of the bare command name

the plan's done-when requires the gate to run on all_debug and its log in the fragment; the gate ran on the fleet node and the fragment says so, leaving a stated done-when unmet even though the run's 53-passed result is recorded

the done-when's named measure is this end-to-end dispatch test, but the manifest records it passing on unchanged code, so it is a guard for the composition route and not the reproduction the done-when asked for; the reproducing test is the probe test at line 176

justifications.durability: tests/test_every_launch_route_runs_the_resolved_command.py:201 fails on the unchanged source with 'lane probe could not run: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: codex', as the recorded baseline arm shows, so reverting the resolution reddens it.
justifications.evidence: the reproduction at tests/test_every_launch_route_runs_the_resolved_command.py:201 and the 53-passed gate are recorded, but the done_when's named end-to-end measure passes on unchanged code and the gate did not run on all_debug as the done_when requires.
justifications.fit: the function-local import at reckon/crew/resumption.py:630 matches the module's existing idiom, but the added test file leaves an unused reckon.flight import (F401) and ruff format would reformat it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/resumption.py:637 resolves the probe's argv through the same rewrite the dispatch, resume and lane-change routes apply, so no launch_plan call site is left running a bare name.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the repository's existing owner, resolve_launch_executable at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:1213, rather than adding a second resolver.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only reckon/crew/resumption.py, its test file and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
